Question Choices: Select True or False. 0.5 x 0.8 = 0.04 ~~TRUE | FALSE~~
Solution: 0.5 = 5/10; 0.8 = 8/10. Multiply: 5 × 8 = 40; denominator 10 × 10 = 100. So 0.5 × 0.8 = 40/100 = 0.4. Therefore the requested answer is FALSE.
